name: Rock Paper Wizard
summary: Wizards gesture-cast spells at each other to shove toward a dragon's gold while shoving rivals toward the cave exit.
rules_text: Each round a row of spell cards forms the communal spellbook. Players are arranged on a linear track from cave mouth to dragon hoard. Simultaneously each player secretly chooses one available spell gesture and a target opponent (or self where allowed). All reveal on 'Wizard!'. Effects resolve in clockwise order starting with the round's first player. Most spells move caster forward and target backward, swap positions, or force retargets. If a player is targeted by Antimagic Field the spell they cast becomes a Wild Surge: replace it with a random card from the deck. Wild surges resolve when that player's turn to resolve comes. After resolution, discard the first card of the spellbook, slide the rest down, deal a new spell to the end, and pass first player. First to reach the treasure space or most advanced when deck ends wins.
rating_reason: RPS bidding gem collecting, simultaneous bluffing perfect fit
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
